hash_convention: prompt.sha256_16 = first 16 hex of sha256 over the prompt text WITHOUT the trailing newline of the .txt file (the exact string sent to var2). sha256sum of the file differs by that newline. Final image files carry file_sha256 (sha256sum of the PNG). A QA verdict holds for that sha only; any code fix makes a new sha and needs QA again.

lessons.small_product_P1: a small product's P1 needs a MEDIUM base (QA: at least ~400x500) that already holds a size anchor (the print beside it, the lamp it replaces), the line "same height as the lamp it replaces (16 cm)", and measurement on the raw against the anchor before any crop. A tiny base (100x125) lets the model invent the product and the room; a loose base lets nano keep the composition and inflate the product (x1.8-2.05).
